events.name: New Orleans Saints at Atlanta Falcons

headlines.description: Drew Brees threw a pair of touchdown passes and the New Orleans Saints overcame a lackluster offensive showing, holding off the Atlanta Falcons 17-13 on Thursday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Brees, Saints finish sweep of rival Falcons

events.name: Tampa Bay Buccaneers at Detroit Lions

headlines.description: Matthew Stafford's fourth interception went in and out of Calvin Johnson's hands inside the Tampa Bay 5 in the final minute, allowing the Buccaneers to hold on for a 24-21 win over the Detroit Lions on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Bucs pick off Stafford 4 times, upset Lions

events.name: Minnesota Vikings at Green Bay Packers

headlines.description: Backup quarterback Matt Flynn threw for 218 yards to help the Packers storm back from a 16-point deficit for a 26-26 tie as the Minnesota Vikings and Green Bay could only muster field goals in overtime Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Flynn, Packers play to rare tie with Vikings

events.name: San Diego Chargers at Kansas City Chiefs

headlines.description: Philip Rivers threw for 392 yards and three touchdowns, the final one a 26-yarder to Seyi Ajirotutu with 24 seconds remaining, to give San Diego a 41-38 victory over the Kansas City Chiefs on Sunday and end the Chargers' three-game losing streak.
headlines.shortLinkText: Rivers rallies Chargers to upset of Chiefs

events.name: Chicago Bears at St. Louis Rams

headlines.description: Tavon Austin's 65-yard touchdown run -- his fourth straight this season from beyond midfield -- jump-started a 21-point first quarter and the St. Louis Rams defense made some big plays, too, in a 42-21 victory over the Chicago Bears on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Rams start fast, hold off Bears' rally attempt

headlines.description: Cam Newton converted a fourth-and-10 situation at his own 20 with a completion to keep alive the Carolina Panthers' final possession, and they went on to score a touchdown with 43 seconds left and beat the Miami Dolphins 20-16 Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Newton carries Panthers to 7th straight win

events.name: New York Jets at Baltimore Ravens

headlines.description: Joe Flacco threw a 66-yard touchdown pass to Jacoby Jones, Justin Tucker kicked four field goals and the Baltimore Ravens shut down the sputtering offense of the New York Jets in a 19-3 victory Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Flacco throws long TD as Ravens drub Jets

headlines.description: Maurice Jones-Drew ran for a season-high 84 yards and a touchdown and the Jacksonville Jaguars extended the Houston Texans' losing streak to a franchise-record nine games with a 13-6 victory.
headlines.shortLinkText: Jaguars send Texans to ninth straight loss

headlines.description: Ryan Fitzpatrick threw a 10-yard touchdown pass to Kendall Wright with 10 seconds remaining to cap a mistake-free performance that put the Tennessee Titans back in playoff contention with a 23-19 victory over the Oakland Raiders on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Fitzpatrick puts Titans back in playoff hunt

headlines.description: Bruce Arians beats old team as Cards rout Colts.
headlines.shortLinkText: Arians beats old team as Cards crush Colts

events.name: Dallas Cowboys at New York Giants

headlines.description: Tony Romo threw two touchdowns and led a drive that set up Dan Bailey' 35-yard field goal on the final play as the Dallas Cowboys defeated the Giants 24-21 Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Romo leads late drive as Cowboys edge Giants

events.name: Denver Broncos at New England Patriots

headlines.description: Stephen Gostkowski kicked a 31-yard field goal for New England after a misplayed punt return by Denver, lifting the Patriots to a 34-31 overtime victory over the Broncos on Sunday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Pats rally from 24 back, stun Broncos in OT

headlines.description: Colin Kaepernick completed 15 of 24 passes for 235 yards with three touchdowns and no interceptions Monday night as the San Francisco 49ers broke a two-game losing streak with a 27-6 win over Washington.
